source_findings: The cached sequences are exact annotated prefixes of longer native image streams. Allowing len(boxes) >= len(sequence)-1 is sufficient for this observed defect; max_query+3 remains inside the cache for every affected sequence.
Exact per-frame box, choice, pause and template-write comparisons are unchanged. A normalized AST comparison confirms collect_sequence has no semantic delta besides the global == to >= comparison.

Resume is explicit. It compares all persisted configuration fields except the new resume flag, rejects completion.json, checks each closed row against all requested query_frames and history_frames=arange(max_query), and validates progress counts and unique sequence membership.

A sequence enters progress.jsonl only after both NPZ files are fully written. The resumed loop skips only validated closed rows, appends to progress.jsonl and recollects an unclosed sequence without adopting partial artifacts. Full EventRolloutData schema and causal-boundary validation still runs before training.

The queue permits only the original COLLECT_FULL_TRAIN stage, reads the saved plan, checks original arms and complete train/validation video membership, preserves finished sanity artifacts and passes --resume only to the four TRAIN collectors. DEV collection begins normally.

AST equality confirms the original read, environment, groups, record, cpu, wave, collect_command and fit functions and every postcollection statement through full training, DEV selection, native evaluation and own-weight cleanup are unchanged.

Saved plan has 16452 unique TRAIN queries over 881 videos and 1824 unique DEV queries over 98 videos, disjoint videos both across shards and between partitions. Four 24-epoch arms retain batch32/seed42, reference or budgeted ranking and lr1e-5 or3e-6. Eight best/last full98 evaluations and protected-parent selection still feed one selected checkpoint to both native datasets.
